name: GM CCA - Reno Parts Distribution Center, Reno NV

fieldNotes.facility: GM Customer Care & Aftersales (CCA) Service Parts Operations Reno PDC, ~404,000 sq ft single-tenant warehouse opened 2003, in the Stead industrial area near Reno-Stead Airport. OSM geocode for 6565 Echo Ave lands on this central N-S warehouse; building footprint (~330m x 105m) matches the published ~404k sq ft, blue corporate signage visible on the NE-corner office in 2019 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible across the truck approach in satellite imagery. Single-tenant DC with an open dock apron running off the internal east-side drive; public Street View is set back from the truck yard so a gate cannot be positively confirmed, but none is apparent - left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone booth structure beside the truck approach. Office function is integrated into the NE corner of the main building.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron on the east face between the dock doors and the access drive provides interior staging/queue room before docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along nearly the full ~330m east face with ~45 mixed-carrier trailers backed in; door count estimated 50+ from overhead imagery, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Numerous parked trailers on the east apron without tractors - a working drop/storage yard; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage along the east apron beyond the active dock positions.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unused paved width and open apron geometry leave room to add a bypass/express check-in lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Stead logistics park north of Reno, abutting high-desert open land and the Reno-Stead general-aviation airport; judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not adjacent.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined in/out access off the internal east drive; lane counts estimated and flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: GM's own facilities locator page for the Reno NV Parts Distribution Center; provides GM service parts for GM dealers and ACDelco customers.

verification.rationale: GM-operated CCA Parts Distribution Center, confirmed by GM-domain facilities locator. No bankruptcy-era/RACER divestiture.
